title_as_printed: Observed results for ethylene in aqueous solutions of a single acid and mixed salts at 1 atm and 25 C

footnotes_as_printed.xi: xi is for the first salt in the mixture

pressure_note: Title: 'at 1 atm and 25 C'; Bunsen coefficient defined in the companion paper (Onda 1970, JCEJ 3, 18) as volume of gas at 0 C and 760 mmHg partial gas pressure per cm3 of solution; this paper only says solubilities are measured at 25 C and 1 atm, expressed as Bunsen absorption coefficients; total vs partial pressure not otherwise stated

ionic_strength_fraction_first_salt.col: xi (ionic strength fraction of first salt)

composition.other_species: Salt system is given by block label rows (group_rows set composition.salts, e.g. 'NaCl+NH4NO3'; first named salt is the one xi refers to; xi = I_first/I, '-' for a single salt, 1/3 means equal ionic-strength fraction for each of three salts). I = total ionic strength in mol/l (Eq. 6, Nomenclature 'total ionic strength [mol/l]'), I_i = (z^2 C + z C)/2 per salt i; per-salt molarities are not tabulated. Species outside the six-ion set present: HNO3, K2CO3, KHCO3, NH4NO3, Na2CO3, NaHCO3. KHCO3+K2CO3 and NaHCO3+Na2CO3: authors found analytically that some CO3(2-) coexists with HCO3(-); presented as two-salt mixtures at approximately constant ionic strength fractions and 'may be less accurate' (text).

volume_basis_evidence: Nomenclature: 'I = total ionic strength [mol/l]', 'Ci = concentration of salt i [mol/l]', 'alpha = Bunsen absorption coefficient [cm3 of gas/cm3 of solution]'
conversion_needs: I (mol/l of solution) to molality of each salt needs xi, salt stoichiometry and solution density (not given)
Bunsen coefficient is per cm3 of salt solution, gas reduced to 0 C, 760 mmHg
notes: xi printed only on first row of each sub-block; filled down on following rows (marked in note column). Printed layout: system name beside first row of each block, written as its own label row. Pure-water reference runs reported only in text (CO2 and C2H4 from the companion paper; C2H2 three runs mean 0.9487, range 0.14%).
quality_remarks: Fig. 4 legend gives xi_NaCl = 0.6579 for the NaCl+HNO3 system whereas Table 2 prints 0.6156 (data rows 26-): table value kept as printed; text/figure disagreement (the other systems agree).
